get.description: The containers (with their ports) and the databases (port 5432) that a connector can reach.

put.description:
Make the connector, or change its token or targets. A new connector needs a token. A missing `targets`
keeps the current targets. A change gives the connector a new revision.

patch.description:
Redeploy with a new image, size, credential or env.

`env` replaces all variables. `env_set` and `env_unset` change only the named variables.

get.description: The last lines of the newest pod. `previous`: the run before the last restart (for a crash).

delete.description: No backups: the data is gone after this.

patch.description:
Turn vector on or off. On: the reconciler runs CREATE EXTENSION. Off: DROP EXTENSION at once,
refused if a column or index uses it.

post.description:
A new password for the role app. The old one works until the reconciler applies the new one
(a few seconds).
Owner only. An existing user is added at once. A new email gets a Supabase invite, then is added.

delete.description: The owner removes a member. A member removes themselves to leave the project.

get.description: Your credentials. With `project_id`, also the credentials of the project owner.

delete.description:
A bucket with objects is refused with 409. Garage is asked for the object count when it can be reached; if it
cannot, the sizes of the last minute check decide. The reconciler deletes the bucket. It checks again: Garage
refuses a bucket that is not empty, and then the bucket goes back to active with its objects.

post.description: Only with no buckets. The reconciler deletes the Garage objects, then the storage row.
Makes the storage row (provisioning) and the account vcluster. Idempotent. The reconciler does the rest.

The row first, then the key in Garage and its access. If Garage does not take the key or the access, the key
and the row go and the request is 502. The secret is in this response only.

delete.description:
Garage first, then the row. If Garage fails, the row stays and the request can be sent again. Once the storage
is disabling, the Garage is going away: only the row goes.

patch.description: A new permission or new buckets are given to Garage at once. If Garage refuses, nothing changes.

post.description:
A new key ID and secret, with the same name, permission and buckets. The order: the new key in Garage, the
old key out of Garage, then the rows change in one transaction. The old key stops working before the new one
is saved, so a failed step never leaves the old key working without a row.
